import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] fact = new int[MAXN], inv_fact = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] fa = new int[19][1 << 19], fb = new int[19][1 << 19], fc = new int[19][1 << 19];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int temp_n = n;
        int[] f = new int[1 << 20];
        Arrays.fill(f, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int mask = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                    mask <<= 1;
                    if ((n & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                        mask |= ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) ? 1 : 0;
                    }
                }
                f[mask] = i;
                temp_n = Math.max(temp_n, mask);
            }
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }

        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            fact[i] = (int)((long)fact[i - 1] * i % p);
        }
        inv_fact[MAXN - 1] = modPow(fact[MAXN - 1], p - 2, p);
        for (int i = MAXN - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv_fact[i] = (int)((long)inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p);
        }

        int size = 1;
        while (size < (temp_n + 1)) size <<= 1;

        int[] a = new int[size];
        for (int i = 0; i <= temp_n; i++) {
            a[i] = inv_fact[f[i]];
        }

        int res = modPow(k, n, p);
        a = subsetPowerConvolution(a, k, p, size);

        int subtract_value = (int)((long)a[temp_n] * fact[n] % p);
        res = (res - subtract_value + p) % p;
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    static int[] performTransform(int[] s, int n, int p, boolean invert) {
        int logn = Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(n) ^ 31; // __lg(n)
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            int step = 1 << i;
            for (int mask = 0; mask < n; mask++) {
                if ((mask & step) != 0) {
                    int prev_mask = mask ^ step;
                    if (!invert) {
                        s[mask] = (s[mask] + s[prev_mask]) % p;
                    } else {
                        s[mask] = (s[mask] - s[prev_mask] + p) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return s;
    }

    static int[] powerConvolution(int[] a, int k, int p, int n) {
        if (k == 1) return a;
        if (k % 2 == 1) {
            int[] prev = powerConvolution(a, k - 1, p, n);
            int[] result = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    long val = (long)prev[i] * a[j] % p;
                    result[i + j] = (int)((result[i + j] + val) % p);
                }
            }
            return result;
        } else {
            int[] half = powerConvolution(a, k / 2, p, n);
            int[] result = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    long val = (long)half[i] * half[j] % p;
                    result[i + j] = (int)((result[i + j] + val) % p);
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static int[] subsetPowerConvolution(int[] a, int k, int p, int size) {
        int LOGN = 19;
        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = (j < a.length) ? a[j] : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            fa[i] = performTransform(fa[i], size, p, false);
        }

        int[] v = new int[LOGN];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) v[j] = fa[j][i];
            v = powerConvolution(v, k, p, LOGN);
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) fc[j][i] = v[j];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            fc[i] = performTransform(fc[i], size, p, true);
        }

        int[] res = new int[size];
        for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                res[j] = fc[i][j];
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int modPow(int base, int exp, int mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) != 0) result = (result * b) % mod;
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int)result;
    }
}
